headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryRat_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryRat r c U L d) =
    (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).π d

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.computedTrace_pi_lower
headlines.statement:

  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),

    (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).π d

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedWalk_mixing
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        ∀
          (hp :
            2 ≤
              Fintype.card
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
          (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (T : ℕ),
          ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.walkLaw (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp)
                  start T)
                (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryLaw r c U L)) ≤
            Math115.PhysicalFiniteWalk.massAllowance r U L *
              Real.exp (-↑T / Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.aggregateMixingAllowance r c U)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledJoinedWalkWord_mixing
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    2 ≤ U →
      7 ≤ L →
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
          ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t T : ℕ),
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                    (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWalkWord r c U L hr hc start (t + 2) (t + 2)
                      (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                      (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                      T))
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.defectStationaryLaw r c U L)) ≤
              ↑T * ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t) +
                Math115.PhysicalFiniteWalk.massAllowance r U L *
                  Real.exp (-↑T / Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.aggregateMixingAllowance r c U)
